sources.entry: Epoch Flip Clock Screensaver - Unix epoch timestamp flip clock screensaver.

summary.one_liner: A macOS screensaver that displays the current Unix epoch timestamp as a flip clock.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Unix epoch flip clock screensaver for macOS. It is installed by downloading a file named "Epock Flip Clock.saver" (spelled this way in the README). The README is very short and gives no details on display options, settings, or how the timestamp is rendered. It links to two related screensavers: Grid Clock Screensaver and Word Clock Screensaver. The repository was listed under the Screensaver section of an awesome-style list of open-source macOS apps.
use_cases: Display a Unix timestamp as a screensaver on a Mac
Decorative flip clock for macOS desktop idle screen
Show epoch time while away from the computer
how_to_run: Download "Epock Flip Clock.saver" from the repository
notable: Shows Unix epoch time as a flip clock
Part of a family with Grid Clock and Word Clock screensavers
caveats: README is very brief; no documentation on settings or customization
